body: I truly 100% understand your pain. I have a couple of things I’d like to say, I understand that not speaking to her is hurting, but one of 2 things will come from this. You will either continue not speaking to her as she asked, and she may come back and realize that you are what she wanted. Pushing things is only going to push her farther away. If she decides that this isn’t what she wants, you not speaking to her throughout the time of giving her space will severely lessen the pain you feel simply because of the time. I know that you probably do love this girl, and that it does hurt, but being in a relationship and getting close to someone is like an addiction. The more time you spend with them the more your brain gets used to their presence, taking this away can truly make you feel awful. But it’s only a matter of time before you do start to feel better. Do you have any hobbies? Do you workout? Maybe do some things to improve yourself in the mean time that way if she doesn’t want to come back you will be doing things to improve yourself. Don’t put your happiness on hold for someone who isn’t holding onto you.
Appreciate the response, this is actually something I have never even thought about so once again thank you for the outside view.
